scope: V2 asynchronous proactive learning and standing-preference guidance

lifecycle.trigger: all delivery receipts accepted and durable completion published
lifecycle.durability: best-effort process-local queue, no restart recovery
lifecycle.forgetCancellation: cancel older pending/in-flight process-local jobs before newer authored forget request

learning.source: current authored text; voice transcription or attachment caption accepted; assistant/OCR/quoted payloads excluded
learning.persistence: existing native owner-scoped Supabase memories store with exact-content reuse and optional compatible embeddings

proactivity.guidance: when preferences are present, adapt relevant requests or verify preferences with the user
proactivity.futureContext: existing standing-preference and relevant-memory readers via bounded readPersonalContext

budgets.auxiliaryUsage: extraction/admission/embeddings logged separately from reasoning loop

validation.productionReadOnlyQuery: active preferences for synthetic nil user, limit 2, returned []
validation.productionBuild: TypeScript packages and emitted runtime compiled; Docker validation not requested for this block

limits: Cancellation is process-local and does not erase already committed writes
No semantic supersession, correction/versioning or durable background outbox
Scripted tests verify protocol, persistence and prompt injection; live model quality and latency not measured
rollback: Revert this proactive-learning unit: scheduling hook, background adapter and provider purpose, persona guidance, tests and docs; explicit memory tools remain independent.
